title: Token bucket rate limiter
summary: Build a token bucket that allows bursts up to its capacity and a steady refill rate after that, with lazy fractional refill and an injectable clock.
hints: You don't need a timer that adds tokens every tick. Store how many tokens there were at the last request and when that was; the current count follows from the elapsed time.
Every call starts with a refill: tokens = min(capacity, tokens + elapsed × refill_rate), then last = now. Keep tokens as a float so half a token is real.

Guard the refill: if now <= last, add nothing and leave last alone (the clock went backwards). Then refuse if cost > capacity or tokens < cost; otherwise subtract cost and allow. A refusal never changes tokens.
